usage: Use 樹幹 for the main woody stem of a tree; it is a neutral, everyday noun in gardening and nature vocabulary.
It often appears with tree-related words such as 樹木, 樹皮, 枝, and 樹葉 when describing parts of a plant.
This word is common in school science, gardening, and outdoor talk; it is not slang and sounds natural in both spoken and written Cantonese.
Learners should remember that 樹幹 refers to the trunk itself, not the roots or branches; in Cantonese it is usually used as a fixed noun phrase.
